Simeon Smith Mansion The Simeon Smith Mansion is a historic farm property on Smith (or Doran) Road in West Haven, Vermont. The property, more than includes a farmhouse dating to the 1790s, which was the seat of Simeon Smith, a prominent local doctor, politician, and landowner. The property was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1991.
